), urban_level2 AS (

    lt2.level2_code AS level2_code
  FROM landcover_type AS lt2
  WHERE
    lt2.level2_label ILIKE '%urban%'
), dominant_grids AS (
  SELECT
    u.latitude AS latitude,
    u.longitude AS longitude,
    CASE
      WHEN dom.level2_code IN (
        SELECT
          forest_level2.level2_code AS level2_code
        FROM forest_level2
      )
      THEN 'Forest'
      WHEN dom.level2_code IN (
        SELECT
          urban_level2.level2_code AS level2_code
        FROM urban_level2
      )
      THEN 'Urban'
      ELSE 'Other'
    END AS landcover_group
  FROM landcover_upscaled AS u
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      lt.level2_code AS level2_code,
      SUM(u.ranks[i][2]) AS total_count
    FROM GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS(u.ranks, 1) AS i
    JOIN landcover_type AS lt
      ON lt.level3_code = u.ranks[i][1]
    GROUP BY
      lt.level2_code
    ORDER BY
      total_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS dom
  WHERE
    (ROUND(CAST(u.latitude AS DECIMAL), 1), ROUND(CAST(u.longitude AS DECIMAL), 1)) IN ((47.4, 8.5))
    AND dom.level2_code IN (
      SELECT
        forest_level2.level2_code AS level2_code
      FROM forest_level2
      UNION
      SELECT
        urban_level2.level2_code AS level2_code
      FROM urban_level2
    )
), time_window_1 AS (
  SELECT
    dg.landcover_group AS landcover_group,
    AVG(t.tmean - 273.15) AS avg_temp_c,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.latitude || ',' || t.longitude) AS num_grids
  FROM meteo_tmean AS t
  JOIN dominant_grids AS dg
    ON dg.latitude = t.latitude AND dg.longitude = t.longitude
  WHERE
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.time) BETWEEN 2015 AND 2016
  GROUP BY
    dg.landcover_group
)

  ROUND(
    CAST(MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN time_window_1.landcover_group = 'Forest'
        THEN time_window_1.avg_temp_c

    CAST(MAX(
      CASE WHEN time_window_1.landcover_group = 'Urban' THEN time_window_1.avg_temp_c END
    ) AS DECIMAL),

question: Find count the longest run of wet days (any rainfall > 0.1 mm) in City of Zurich during the year 2018.

WITH time_window_1 AS (
  SELECT
    DATE(mtp.time) AS day
  FROM meteo_tp AS mtp
  WHERE
    (
      ROUND(CAST(mtp.latitude AS DECIMAL), 1),
      ROUND(CAST(mtp.longitude AS DECIMAL), 1)
    ) IN ((47.4, 8.5))
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mtp.time) = 2018
  GROUP BY
    DATE(mtp.time)
  HAVING
    SUM(mtp.tp) > 0.0001
), streaks AS (
  SELECT
    time_window_1.day AS day,
    (
      time_window_1.day - (
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY time_window_1.day) * INTERVAL '1 DAY'
      )
    ) AS grp
  FROM time_window_1
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS duration
FROM streaks
GROUP BY
  streaks.grp
ORDER BY
  duration DESC
LIMIT 1
